title: Tenma Tsukasa — Shining Stars Onstage〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (To think I could get ginger fried pork-wrapped rice balls at a food stall...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A happy belly will give me energy for the rest of the day. My preparations are complete!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Rehearsal went well too. I just can't wait to perform for everyone!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that Morisawa? He's looking quite seriously at his hand. What is he—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you alright? You sounded as though you were in pain...

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Oh... No, it really wasn't anything big. Sorry to make you worry.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: The truth is, I was just pulling a lotto here at this stall. They have figures from “Chousentai Flash Giranger!”

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: But no matter how many I pull, I just keep getting the monsters...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, so that's why you seemed so distressed.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Yeah. The monsters have their good points too, so it's not like I'm super upset... But I want the hero!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, maybe I can be of help!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I once drew “super great blessing” from the omikuji, you know! I have full confidence in my luck! If we draw together, surely some will transfer to you!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line:
Thank you! You really are such a good guy!
Okay, sorry to ask, but please help me out!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line:
Yes! All thanks to you, Tenma!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me! I'm just glad to see you smile, Morisawa.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line:
Man, you're so cool!
You're just like a superhero!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: I hear a young boy crying. Look at these crowds... He could have gotten lost. I'll go see if I can find him.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll come with you, Morisawa. As a future star, I can hardly abandon a crying child!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Hehe, I knew you'd say that, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Let's hurry! We have a smile to deliver!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: That boy should be here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, are you going to keep on crying forever?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
*Sob*
B-But...! I finally got my Giranger...!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, but then you dropped it.
Here, we'll get you one more later, okay?

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Hmm... That seems to be his mother with him. At least he isn't lost...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Giranger, he said. That would be the same hero as the figure you won just now, yes?

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Yeah. It sounds like he's upset about losing the one he won.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Excuse me, young man! Would you play with these figures with me?

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: I love the monsters so much, you see, but I've been looking for someone brave enough to be the hero!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Would you play Giranger and do battle with me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Even though Morisawa loves the hero best himself...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He must be doing this to make the boy smile.)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: My goodness, are you from RYUSEITAI? I'm sorry for the trouble, and thank you.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line:
No, thank you! Now, let's begin!
“Curse you, Giranger! I will destroy yooou! Groaaaaaar!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “HAH HAH HAH HAH! Don't celebrate just yet, Giranger! I'm FAR more powerful than he is!”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I'll defeat you, too! Flash Beam!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Pegasus Barrier! Hah, you call that an attack?! It didn't even tickle me!”

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: “Thanks for the backup, Monster Pegasus! Wahaha! With the two of us together, you stand no chance without your Final Flash Attack!”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Then here goes!
Final Flash Attack... Sunlight Sparkle Flash!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were a fierce opponent, young man!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Hmm... I know. Would you accept this hero figure?

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Of course! It belongs with a brave warrior who defeated the forces of evil!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: As you can see, I'm more of a monster fan myself. Please, accept it!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Really, I can't thank you enough...

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Please don't worry about it! Making children smile is my job!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Even though he wanted that figure so much himself... He looks so satisfied with the smile on that boy's face.)

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Phew... We were able to make him smile after all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As expected of a hero of RYUSEITAI!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Don't be silly! That boy smiled because of you, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Your monster performance delighted him, after all... And without you, I might not have even had that figure in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: So, what brought his smile back was our shared feelings, our desires to make him happy, resonating.
A few hours later - Before the show

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Right! Time for the brightest star of the night to shine and make this the best performance ever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will— with a strong, kindhearted hero by my side!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Haha, you're right. After all, the same wish burns red-hot in both our hearts!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's go bring smiles to our audience, with the power of our radiance!
